message:
Minimoon Now, Big Honeymoon Later?

A minimoon means leaving right after the wedding for a short trip, then taking the big honeymoon later. It lets you decompress without the pressure (and expense) of planning a major trip during an already busy time.

There's no rule: do what fits your energy and budget.

Read the full guide: https://bridalteam.com/guides/honeymoon-planning-guide?utm_source=facebook&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=2026-11&utm_content=2026-11-24-noon-minimoon-or-honeymoon
